brief:
The post that tagged the bot says:
@buildthis.bisks.net a quick thing to go find people that put me on lists that make no sense and add them back to one of the same

What that post carries with it (this is what it's pointing at):
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [quoting @asura.dev: I keep meaning to make a quick thing to go find people that put me on lists that make no sense and add them back to one of the same.

It isn't as bad anymore, but I used to get simultaneous adds in the same hour to libtard/fascist, muskhater/samalover, etc and it was all bananas.]
note: built listkarma: enter a handle, see every list they're on and who put them there, sign in and add any curator to one of your own lists (manual, per click, confirm first).
